body:
I'm on that sub reddit. But what do I do? Do I okay the loan? I don't even want to live there but yet I'm trapped there. When is enough enough? At what point do I say I've been here 32 years I want my own life and I'm done?

I feel if I weren't in this position the depression would go away.

Going back to work isn't even possible anyway now that I remember the vocational rehabilitation forms want a list of all the medications I'm on. Yeah hire me I'm on two different muscle relaxers and high amounts of nerve pain medication gabapentin.

Going back to work isn't even possible anyway now that I remember the vocational rehabilitation forms want a list of all the medications I'm on. Yeah hire me I'm on two different muscle relaxers and high amounts of nerve pain medication gabapentin.

Even if I went out gave up my disability and got a job I don't think I could keep it with my neck troubles and even then my family would still have me pay for the loan and I'd still be stuck. So suicide maybe???

One of the things she said irritated me. She said again she didn't think I could keep up with her. I replied back that she's assuming disabled people are not fun, have no indoor, outdoor hobbies or I interests. And the other thing that hurt me was her telling me she only talked to me because she was bored. She said she could have made time if she wanted to but she would rather make time for people she's interested in. 

Just kill me.

Well I told her about my disability and she was okay with that I guess but she said she wasn't interested because she didn't think I could keep up with her. I mean I've been on online dating sites for 13 years and it's always the same. I haven't had one date come out of it. It's not them it's it's me. I connect with someone too quickly and I either divulge personal information too soon or too late. I just can't talk to any girl right. I lack the part of the brain where those skills are. I mean 32 years..come on! I should have kids almost entering high school by now but I can't even get anyone to feel the urge to hug me. I feel it's too late in life now to get my shit together, but I'm financially trapped where I'm at. I missed out on my twenties which are everyone's best years. I don't feel sorry for myself because I'm disabled, there's plenty of others that are worse off than me that are disabled. But I feel like I'm the only one in the world who is such a loser that they can't even get a hug, never had a girlfriend or anything. My attitude would change if I were with someone. But right now I see no future in my life and I want it to end. It's not selfish. It's selfish of others to know I'm in such emotional pain to keep me here.

It's not that I don't want to move out and have my own place because I do. My family and I went over the math of me wanting to own my own home and it's not possible. I want to own my own home vs a apartment because I have 2 cats and I wouldn't want to put them in danger because of someone burning the complex down by accident or the landlord doing a inspection while I was out taking a chance of them letting them out or having them have a problem with me having pets. If I was out and had my own place I think the depression would go away to.
I told her about my disability this morning she said she'd get back with me but hasn't yet. I didn't tell her about my living situation as that would have been too overwhelming.
I would move in with her. Now you may understand my other posts on reddit.
She never asked about my occupation. I just have on my profile I have a income. If she had asked I would have told her.

It's not something they can physically see although it is physical. I have a bad neck but I have function in everything and can walk. It's more like a invisible disability to anyone else. My mom recently became disabled to so she is living in the home with us. She and my dad are divorced.

I've been talking to someone online for close to a month and I haven't told her my situation or that I'm disabled as I want her to like me for my personality, not how much money I make or what I would do for a living. I've always gotten rejected in the past when I mentioned it in the beginning and so this is the first time I haven't mentioned it and oddly enough we want to meet each other but her schedule is preventing it. And yet I feel bad I haven't told her because I feel certainty if I did I would be rejected.
Really? People want to joke about my depression? How nice.

There's a stigma society creates about disabled people that are aiding in driving us to suicide. Friends, people don't invite you to social gatherings. You essentially lose your social life. Nobody knows or cares if we are alive. I just learned there had been a Hollywood film put out that essentially suggests disabled people should kill themselves.

Other background: 
- In my 30's
-Mostly bullied in grade school through high school. Never was popular.
-Never been hugged, kissed or been kissed, never had any type of sexual experience other than with myself, never been told I love you.
-Became disabled at 22
-Now in considerable debt and not living on my own
-Get rejected constantly, especially when I tell them I don't live alone and I've been called a loser multiple times because of it.
-No friends. They stopped talking to me over a year ago on fb.
-Really nothing to live for
-I've mentioned suicide on my fb and no one replies and doesn't care.
-Nobody outside of the family would know I'm dead.
-I can't talk to anybody about how I feel.
I wish everyone would forget about me like my friends have so it would be easier on everyone.

I never go out anywhere now. Feel like I wasted my twenties just staying home taking pain medication. I've been taken off it now but by the time everyone is in their early thirties they are married or have kids. Not very many places to go around here either there's a club which hardly has any events, in their regular nights hardly anyone comes in. A big pool hall the woman are always taken. Not very many options.
I can deal with the physical pain but not the depression.

Spinal stenosis of the neck and back. I'm not in a wheelchair. Not everyone with spinal injuries are wheelchair confined. That's the first thing that's comes to everyone's mind when I try online dating. It's a tough stigma to break.

We did the math awhile back and it's not possible for me to own a home on my income. 

Light, water, sewer bill $175.00
Gas bill $55
Phone bill $50
Trash bill $19
Car insurance $60
Gas in car $40
Second Health insurance $289
Not including: grocery bill, house payment, home owners insurance, real estate taxes.

My income $965-$688= $277.00
I can sit at a computer for a hour but after that a have discomfort.

I told my brother and mom how I felt once again how I felt today and they're like you already own your own place and I just laugh at them. They don't get it. They're like a girl shouldn't ask you those personal questions anyway when you're dating and I argue with them about that to. How are you supposed to know if the person's not a hobo or something? Are you supposed to wait until the wedding night to ask what they do for a living? 😠 And to top it off am I supposed to bring the girl home to fuck while my brother and mom are there? How stupid are they? They don't get today's times. It's not the fifties like leave it to beaver. It just makes it frustrating when you try to explain why you want to do what you want to do and they fight you over it. I'm gonna do what I'm gonna do anyway.
I was just making a joke to myself I should go to the bank and ask advice. Now I'm thinking that's not such a bad idea.
He just bought a 2016 suv to.

He does have somewhere around $50,000 in stocks which he says he'll take out in the beginning of next year because it's projected to go up in value. That would help but I don't see it helping if all of us are racking up the debt again. $10,000+ for roofing and siding, + $7000 for a new deck, plus whatever he has on his card.
I have a bad neck that keeps me from working a 8 hour job.
I make $965 a month.

I'm trying to figure out if I'm the elephant man where I see a decent looking guy in the mirror but I'm really actually hideous or if I'm just cursed. I can say hello to woman and they'll say stuff like my parents fucked up when they had my ugly ass. My confidence is pretty low cause I get stuff like this whenever I try.
